original_record.question_en: Which new sections did the NR-U study (TR 38.889) add to TS 38.211-38.214? (PHY-layer reference)
original_record.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.889'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(ti:TRImpact {impactType: 'NewSection'})-[:IMPACTS_SECTION]->(s:Section) RETURN tr.trNumber, ti.affectedSection, s.sectionId, ti.impactDescription ORDER BY s.sectionId

author_CQ_record.question: NR-U 연구(TR 38.889)가 TS 38.211~38.214에 어떤 새로운 Section을 추가했는가? (PHY 계층 개발팀 참조용)
author_CQ_record.cypher: MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber: '38.889'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(ti:TRImpact {impactType: 'NewSection'})-[:IMPACTS_SECTION]->(s:Section) RETURN tr.trNumber, ti.affectedSection, s.sectionId, ti.impactDescription ORDER BY s.sectionId

scope_rule: Original NR-U study, target TS38.211 through TS38.214, actual newly added sections. Manual mapping counts and unrelated work-item expansions are diagnostics only.
